Plans and coordinates applicable local drug activities (from local purchase or reimbursement to drug destruction). Sets up and maintains the study in CTMS at study country level as well as local websites as required by local laws and regulations. Oversees, manages and coordinates monitoring activities from site activation through to study closure at country and site level in accordance with the Monitoring Plans. Reviews monitoring visit reports (as required and following Sponsor SOPs) and pro-actively advices the monitor(s) on study related matters.
